one_line: AI spending surges, regulators act, and safety incidents surface across the industry.

themes.title: AI spending drives infrastructure expansion
themes.text: Big tech firms have committed over $3 trillion to data‑center leases, equipment and energy, while startups such as Runware plan a factory to mass‑produce AI inference pods and Fujifilm is expanding magnetic‑tape capacity fivefold for generative‑AI archiving. Baseten raised $2 billion, and Core 4 Solutions listed a 300‑rack Nvidia A100 supercomputer for $59.7 million.

stories.headline: Big tech firms commit over $3 trillion to AI data‑center spending
Runware plans factory to mass‑produce AI pods at car‑assembly line speed
Fujifilm to boost magnetic tape production fivefold as AI drives data archiving
Baseten launches $2 billion funding round, valuation up to $30 billion
Core 4 Solutions lists decommissioned Nvidia A100 supercomputer on eBay for $59.7 million

themes.title: Regulators tighten AI data rules
themes.text: The UK High Court dismissed Meta, TikTok and X’s challenge to Ofcom’s data‑request notices, while the Competition and Markets Authority opened a probe into Meta’s terms for publishers and advertisers. OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic also adopted a shared robots.txt token to let publishers opt out of AI scraping.

stories.headline: UK high court rejects Meta, TikTok and X challenge to Ofcom data requests
UK competition regulator probes Meta's terms for publishers and advertisers
OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic adopt shared robots.txt opt‑out standard

themes.title: AI safety measures and threats
themes.text: OpenAI added stricter limits on weapon‑related advice for teen ChatGPT users. A malicious version of Anthropic’s Claude Code VS Code extension and a similar Claude Code extension from Cursor were found to install persistent SSH backdoors, potentially affecting up to 5,000 developers before being replaced.

stories.headline: OpenAI tightens weapons‑related information limits for teen ChatGPT users
Malicious Claude Code VS Code extension adds SSH backdoor, affecting up to 5,000 users
Anthropic’s Claude VS Code extension backdoored on Cursor, affecting up to 5,000 users
